sample1_text: I think, on balance, the draft is mostly there, though I wonder if the opening could land a little softer. It might just be me, but the middle section feels like it moves quite fast. Perhaps worth sitting with it another day before sending. Not a big deal either way, just a thought.
sample2_completions: The thing I'd tell someone new to this is it's usually fine to ask, people don't mind as much as you'd think.
What actually annoys me is when feedback lands as criticism when it wasn't meant that way.
If I'm honest, the hardest part was learning to say the hard thing kindly.
The way I'd explain this to a friend is most conflict is just two people who care, talking past each other.
render_input: This report demonstrates a robust and transformative approach to the quarterly review process. It is important to note that stakeholder alignment was achieved through a seamless, data-driven methodology, which underscores the paramount value of the initiative.

refinement.freetext: needs more softening, I never state things this flatly
